`final class DepthRange`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.matrix` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DepthRange.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/matrix/DepthRange.java)

Converts a projection from the OpenGL depth range, -1 to 1, to a clip space whose depth goes from 0 to 1.

## Description

A backend whose API expects a depth from 0 to 1, such as Vulkan, converts the projection with it before it writes the matrix into the uniforms of a shader.
X and Y stay as they are.
